title: Ledger and Alibi
author: Sebastian Kavanagh
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
